products.name: EX Trainer Kit: Latias & Latios
products.note: Two half decks, Latias and Latios, each with one cosmos-holofoil Pokémon (Latias 4, Latios 2), plus rule books, a playmat, damage and status counters and a coin, and one booster pack of an EX-series set that no source names. The pack is not simulated. Opening it from either half-deck page deals both 30-card decks.
products.priceSource: The kit's own TCGplayer listing (product 98950) has no price; priced at its 60 cards' market prices added up (both 30-card decks; the booster pack is not counted).
